Superlatives and Not Only but Also (Long Adjectives)
You use superlatives to talk about a noun with more of a quality than the others of the same kind. Not only but also is used to mention a parallel or even an additional idea.

In order to form superlatives with short adjectives, you need to use the definite article The , and the adjective with the -est suffix.

Example:
This is the cheapest computer in the market.

With long adjectives (two or more syllables), you need to use the most and the adjective.

Example:
Ecofriendly computers are the most innovative idea nowadays.

The expression not only… but also is used in separate clauses. But also… provides an additional piece of information.

Examples:
Technology is not only one of the most useful tools to men but also the most harmful for the environment.
Recycling technological materials is not only the most effective but also the most affordable way to reduce pollution.
They will not only be the most functional but also the most ecofriendly devices on the planet.
It has resulted in not only the lightest but also the most energy-efficient devices.
You can use modal verbs to express different shades of sense with other verbs. However, you can use them with adjectives to describe people, things or situations.

The most common modal verbs are can, could, should, and may . In order to introduce an adjective after de modal verb , you need to use verb to be in base form (that is without to ).

Examples: Modern computing can be harmful to the environment.
Energy-saving devices could be inexpensive in the future.
Computer manufacturers should be aware of pollution.
Newer technologies may be greener .

images.text:
Sue: I found this interesting article about some innovations in the computer field, which is related to the environment.
Joan: It could be helpful for our report on computers and energy consumption. We need to write something for our class!
Sue: I know! Let's read it to see if it can help us: "Green PCs are the future of computing. They will not only be the most functional but also the most eco-friendly devices on the planet. Engineers are currently working to reduce pollution caused by technology. It can be difficult because all the processes, from the manufacture, the daily use and the disposal of hardware, take a toll on our planet."

Joan: Wow, it may be convenient for our report! I'm writing some ideas. Keep going!
Sue: Okay…
"The components of computer systems, like hardware, drives, screens, etc. have become less energy-draining over the last years, which has resulted in not only the lightest but also the most energy-efficient devices. However, the process of manufacturing and disposing of technology continues to be a big concern for the environment. Experts suggest that the manufacturing process be more compact and cleaner. This can be achieved by making smaller units, recycling products, and by reusing them as much as possible."

Joan: The recycling part may be expanded; it doesn't show enough details for our report. But I got some really meaningful sentences. Continue, please.
Sue: Let's see…
"Regarding the disposal of computer systems, users should be more responsible, especially since recycling is not only the cheapest but also the most effective way of stopping pollution. One of the major innovations of the field is the creation of devices that are easier to disassemble, so that their parts can be used again in others."
Joan: Great, we still need more sources, though.
